module.emailrep.checks: Collects the domain's email addresses published on the site (at most 5) and queries EmailRep (key required): credential leaks, breaches, malicious activity. Addresses are masked in the result.
module.emailrep.fix:
For each address whose credentials leaked: from a clean device, change the mailbox password, then revoke the open sessions, tokens and app passwords; if the same password is used elsewhere, change it too.
Check that nobody left a backdoor in the mailbox: automatic forwarding or redirect rules, delegations, authorized apps (PowerShell snippet for Microsoft 365 below; same checks in the Google Workspace admin console or your host's console).
Turn on multi-factor authentication on these mailboxes; prefer security keys or passkeys (FIDO2) over codes sent by SMS.
Address found in a breach: the leak often comes from a third-party service where it was used to sign up; change the password if it was reused and ask the person to stop using their work address for external services.
Address linked to malicious activity or on a blocklist: check the sent-mail log for spam sent from the mailbox, and make sure SPF, DKIM and DMARC protect the domain so nobody can spoof the address.
Reduce the personal addresses published on the site (home page, contact page, security.txt): prefer role addresses such as `contact@example.com` or `security@example.com` and a contact form, because bots harvest these addresses for phishing.
Train the people concerned about phishing (emails asking for a password, a code or a transfer): an address whose credentials leaked is a priority target.
Run the scan again: EmailRep checks at most 5 addresses and the free key is limited to 10 requests per day; if the quota is reached, try again the next day.
module.emailrep.fix_snippet:
# PowerShell (Microsoft 365)
Connect-ExchangeOnline
Get-InboxRule -Mailbox user@example.com | Format-List Name,Enabled,ForwardTo,ForwardAsAttachmentTo,RedirectTo
Get-Mailbox user@example.com | Format-List ForwardingAddress,ForwardingSmtpAddress,DeliverToMailboxAndForward
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "User.RevokeSessions.All"
Revoke-MgUserSignInSession -UserId user@example.com
module.emailrep.title: EmailRep (address reputation)
module.emailrep.why: A published address whose credentials leaked is an entry point for phishing and account takeover.
